name: OpenVibe.Inventory

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP, with the outbox relay's state; the database is what ready checks

resumes.what: sign-in sessions are cookies verified against Network's keys, fetched again at boot
kinds and Live's definitions are registered again at boot (idempotent); every grant, equip and ledger row was committed with its event in one transaction
events written before the stop and not yet sent leave event_outbox when the relay starts
OpenVibe.Events redelivers network.account.export_requested and network.account.deleted that were pending during the stop (at least once; account_data_events applies each export and deletion once)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: migration 0001 only creates Inventory's own tables; Live keeps its own cosmetics tables until the switch (ADR-054 §8)

leases.none: no claims: one process serves the site and the API

notes: Port 5030, unit openvibe-inventory.service, inventory.openvibe.network (the openvibe.network wildcard certificate). The network-wide inventory (ADR-054): item kinds (a contract plus a renderer per surface), definitions (itd_), instances (inv_), the equipped set and an append-only ledger in its own PostgreSQL database (ov_inventory). Issuers (services, apps) grant only within their namespace; people equip what they own; public reads need no token. Nothing is sold, bought, traded or converted until a later money ADR (ADR-012, ADR-025). Live's 70 cosmetics are seeded at boot as definitions issued by service:live (Live's item ids kept as aliases), and scripts/import-live.js moves Live's unlocks and equipped slots here row for row; Live then reads through this API (INVENTORY_AUTHORITY). Answers account export and deletion (ADR-033). inventory.definition.review stays planned until creator submissions open.

site.name: Inventory
site.tagline: Your items, on every OpenVibe site.
site.what: Keep the items you earn across OpenVibe in one place, and choose what you wear in chat, on stream overlays and on your profile.
